HENCE, PROVISION TO BE KEPT FOR INCREASING OF PO QUANTITY BY 25%. (3) MORTAR SHOULD HAVE GOOD WORKABILITY AND SHOULD BE EVENLY GROUND. IT SHOULD BE OF SU CH QUALITY AND PLASTICITY AS WOULD ENABLE IT TO SPREAD SATISFACTORILY WITH A TROWEL WHEN M IXED AND TEMPERED WITH ADEQUATE AMOUNT OF WATER. (4) WORKABILITY TEST FOR MORTAR : THE WORKABILITY OF MORTAR SHALL BE TESTED BY USING MORTA R ON 230*113 MM SURFACE OF THREE STANDARD SIZE SILICA BRICKS, (230*113*65 MM) AND PRESSING I T TOGETHER. WAIT FOR 10 MINUTES. THEN LIFT THE TOP BRICK BY HAND, THE BRICKS SHOULD NOT GET DISLODGED (FALL).
